## Test evidence

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run eval` if this touches `brain/agent` or `brain/plugins`

CI also runs `npm run test:coverage` and `npm run build`.

## Docs

- [ ] `docs/todo.md` ticked if this closes a line

## Secrets

- [ ] No `.dev.vars`, no keys, no tokens in the diff

## Plugin tools

- [ ] Plugin tools stay plural (set in, list out, or `single` says why)

Check this too when the pull request does not change a tool.
